items.title: Hunt capacity, private queues and chat updates
items.body:
Both hosts now enforce hunt limits so concurrent requests cannot overload a server: five temporary hunts on the primary and three on the worker. The latest upstream listener-readiness fixes are deployed on both hosts. Pangar, Blaze Patrol and Shock Escalation passed startup checks; complete in-game runs still need confirmation.

Private solo hunts now bypass public queues, and players in the same world receive a shared chat-session ID. Existing parties remain together. The key bot sends one invitation per user and prevents duplicate bot processes. Existing launcher keys and saved progression remain unchanged.

items.title: 30 free cosmetics and matchmaking update
items.body:
The shop now contains 30 free cosmetic offers, with no bounty-token bundles. Purchases made from the earlier larger free catalog have been revoked using purchase records. Pre-owned items, separately earned items, character progress and escalation progress were preserved. Items bought from the new 30-item shop remain yours.

The latest merged matchmaking update is live on both servers. It handles concurrent groups and repeated joins without allocating duplicate hunts, keeps status requests responsive, and confirms native listening readiness. Identical character-save retries are now accepted without overwriting newer progress. Some native hunt crashes remain under investigation.

items.title: Hunt startup improvements, store enabled and bot recovery
items.body:
Game servers now confirm that a hunt is listening before sending players to it. Matchmaking requests stay responsive during cold starts, and new hunts allow more time for the first player to load. These changes are live on both hosts. Some hunt crashes and capacity-related waits are still under investigation; this update does not claim every menu return is resolved.

The in-game store is enabled with the current free catalog. Discord key commands now recover automatically after bot-process failures and load their saved configuration on every restart. Existing account keys and saves are unchanged.

items.title: Poet fix — launcher 0.1.18 and Discord account linking
items.body:
Launcher 0.1.18 adds the Poet fix for persistent oversized-display startup crashes. Open Settings and enable “Poet fix · safe window (1280×720)”, then press Play. It resets saved display size, mode and position before each launch, including when no broken resolution is saved. Changed settings are backed up; other preferences and your account are preserved. If it still crashes, send a fresh game log from that attempt.

Already registered using an old Join invite? That invite is not your account key. In launcher Settings, choose “Save a backup of your key…”, then copy the value after Key: into /key link key:. The response is private and linking keeps your original account and progress. Discord command registration has also been stabilized; reload Discord if an old command remains cached.

The private owner dashboard now displays linked accounts and bot-issued, redeemed, unused, pending and revoked invites. These counts come from saved records and survive dashboard restarts.

items.title: Discord invites fixed and both-server dashboard totals
items.body:
/key claim now sends a complete dauntless-revived://join invite. Paste the entire invite into the launcher's Join box, then register. If you previously received only a DR code, run /key claim again. An invalid-character issue in generated registration codes has also been corrected. Existing account keys and progression are unchanged.

The owner dashboard now shows each server's hunts, CPU and RAM together, with combined hunt/RAM totals and a clearly labelled mean CPU. For example, 50% and 5% average to 27.5%. Offline or stale readings are not counted as zero load. Both-server connection checks and private operator documentation have been updated.

items.title: Launcher 0.1.17 — joltik! fix and account recovery
items.body:
Launcher 0.1.17 is available. The joltik! fix checks for missing Microsoft Visual C++ x64 and legacy DirectX components before launch, with official installation links. Unexpected game exits now show an error instead of silently returning to Play.

The launcher repairs impossible saved display sizes that can cause a Direct3D startup crash, backing up the old settings first. It also checks your account key before launching and asks you to restore the original key if the server rejects it.

Already have an account? Use /key link key:<your original launcher key> to link Discord privately. Linking saves the association in the account database and keeps your existing key and progress. /key claim supplies a registration code, not a replacement login key.

Overflow hosting is active. The owner dashboard now has a Server #2 section with service health, hunts, CPU, memory, disk and process statistics. Please report remaining gameplay issues.

items.title: Overflow hosting and server CPU update
items.body: New hunts can now be assigned to a second game server when the main server is busy. Party rosters and hunt settings travel together, while accounts and progression remain shared. Existing hunts stay on the host where they started. Capacity checks remain active on both hosts, and game ports open only for authenticated players. This adds room for concurrent hunts; it does not guarantee that every reported gameplay or connection issue is resolved. Dedicated game processes now use a 30-frame server tick cap, reducing excess replication work. The cap affects server simulation pacing, not your client rendering FPS.

items.title: Training settings, server performance and Discord codes
items.body: Training Grounds now starts with its explicit game mode and 12-player catalog capacity. Server networking now avoids repeated channel scans and unnecessary replication work in empty worlds. Hunt capacity was expanded, and additional overflow hosting is being prepared. Revived Warden now supports /key claim to DM a single-use registration code and /key status to check redemption. Enter the code when creating your account in the launcher. Launcher 0.1.16 refreshes news automatically. If the Windows installer fails, the Windows ZIP on the release page can be extracted and run directly.

items.title: Server update: Escalation progression and faster hunt launches
items.body:
Real Escalation progression and saving are now enabled. Players without saved progress begin at level 0 instead of the previous placeholder maximum.

This update also separates player connection limits, releases completed hunt slots sooner, and reduces the delay between server launches. A respawn correction has been deployed for the reported under-map issue; please report any remaining cases.

Training Grounds, party invitations, and hunt joining are being investigated. Further updates will appear here.
